Elaine (People Ops): Quick heads-up — microtown this Wed 09:00 PT (30m). Agenda: 1) Q1 wins & metrics (Sam) 2) Dedicated GA callout (Aisha) 3) Security policy update (Sree) 4) Ops hiring & action items. Drop Qs below or DM me. Calendar: https://cal.example/meeting/1715000000 :calendar:
Sam (CEO): Will do a short roadmap highlight, ~6 slides. Keep Qs tight so we stay within 30m.
Aisha (Product): Demo slot for Dedicated GA — need a 5min slide + a 60–90s demo clip. @Jia can you handle the clip?
Jia (Marketing): Yep — will prep a 90s clip and upload to the shared drive by Tue noon.
Mario (Eng): Timezone check — will captions be available? I'm on travel that morning.
Elaine (People Ops): Yes — we'll record and enable live captions. Recording + captions posted here after the call.
Sree (Security): FYI we'll announce a change to hosted default data retention (opt-out enterprise path). We'll share the FAQ slide and full policy doc post-call. Post policy Qs here.
Aisha (Product): Also covering cost-control knobs and rollout timeline. If you foresee customer concerns, ping me directly.
deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "Microtown — Q1 Pulse" Wed 09:00 PT. Link: https://cal.example/meeting/1715000000

Slides/clip: https://drive.example/slides-1715002000 :page_facing_up:
Sam (CEO): Thanks team. Short, focused update — main priorities are reliability and predictable pricing. :muscle:
Sree (Security): Policy doc (internal): https://internal.example/policies/data-retention-v2 — comments open for 48h.
Aisha (Product): Demo clip is uploaded in the slides folder. Ping me for followups or customer notes.
Elaine (People Ops): Missed the live Q&A? Add your question here: https://internal.example/allhands-qna-1715002000 — we'll follow up within 48h.
Jia (Marketing): Thanks all — will spin up the social brief for customers after GA is public.
Mario (Eng): Appreciate the captions — caught up via recording, thanks. :thumbsup:
